name: @loom/experience-recompose
description: loom-ui slice 6a reference: an agent revision lands while the user types into a form. A scripted planner composes an experience with an app-registered NoteInput kind (a real <textarea>), the user types into it, the planner revises (adds, reorders, relabels, drops), and renderBlueprintDom's handle.update patches the live tree by widget id — the textarea keeps its text, caret and focus; the kept metric keeps its element; only the changed nodes move.
